{c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Critical Strikes with {c_important}Shapeshifting{/c} Skills have up to a {c_number}{SF_0}%{/c} chance to grant {c_important}{u}Berserking{/u}{/c} for {c_number}{SF_1}{/c} seconds.

{c_important}{u}Berserking{/u}{/c} increases the damage of {c_important}Shapeshifting{/c} Skills by {c_number}[{SF_2}*100|x%|]{/c}.
